title: Understanding the Code
text: The code is checking how many games have more than one winner. It uses $$`\operatorname{value_{counts}}\left(\right)`$$ to count the number of times each $$`game_{id}`$$ appears where `win` is $$1$$. Then, it checks if all these counts are equal to $$1$$.

title: Analyzing the Condition
text: The condition $$`sum(counts \neq 1)==0`$$ will be true if there are no games with more than one winner. This means every game should have exactly one winner.

hintAnswer: There is exactly one winner per game.
